title: Sharp Exponential Asymptotics for Normal Sign Matrices
summary: Let $M_n$ be an $n\times n$ random matrix whose entries are independent Rademacher random variables, and put $N=\binom n2$. We prove \[ Pr(M_nM_n^T=M_n^TM_n)=2^{-N+O(n)}. \] This gives the sharp exponential order for the probability that a random sign matrix is normal. The lower bound is supplied by symmetric sign matrices. We also record the immediate consequence that random $0$-$1$ matrices have the same sharp exponential normality probability.
